suite: V2.5.2 — Android Build Reproducibility & Device Smoke Test
note: V2.5.2 adds 14 new suites on top of V2.5.1's 176: gradlew JVM opts fix (args were passed as Gradle arguments instead of JVM arguments, preventing any build), PlayBillingBridge JS interface injection and origin validation, native callback ID uniqueness (AtomicLong + ConcurrentHashMap), Base64 + evaluateJavascript callback resolution, JS shim Promise wrapping with 120s timeout, native concurrency guard for billing flows, purchase tokens never logged, BillingWebViewActivity cleanup on destroy, PlayBillingBridge.destroy() state reset, mixed content blocking, recovery scenario analysis (fulfill succeeds → credit fails → unconsumed purchase recovered on restart), AndroidManifest permissions and restrictions, Gradle build configuration consistency, TwaActivity delegation. Android build blocked by dl.google.com proxy restriction (HTTP 403). Gradlew script fixed but AGP/AndroidX/BillingClient cannot be downloaded.
